title: SAKE: Self-aware Knowledge Exploitation-Exploration for Grounded Multimodal Named Entity Recognition
authors: Jielong Tang; Xujie Yuan; Jiayang Liu; Jianxing Yu; Xiao Dong; Lin Chen; Yunlai Teng; Shimin Di; Jian Yin
why_relevant: Proposes an agentic framework that decides when to retrieve based on self-assessed uncertainty, penalizing unnecessary retrieval—relevant to adaptive retrieval/calibration control. However, it targets GMNER rather than general RAG robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Application-specific to multimodal NER; robustness aspects are tangential and not the primary focus.
suggested_section: Calibration and control: when to retrieve
